name: Corrupted Sabers
label: Quest
description: Corrupted Sabers: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: This corrupted water can be used to our advantage, friend. With just a small amount of the water, my kitten doubled in size, and seems to be stronger... Somehow. These cats may prove useful...
Here, friend. Take this cat carrier, and release the kitten inside next to the moon well in the Ruins of Constellas. Heh, heh... I'm sure you'll be pleased with the results!
Return the cat to me, and I'm sure I can make it worth your time.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Don't tell me that you can't go back there! Get going!

clips.title: Completion
paras: The forsaken will resort to any means necessary to crush the alliance! The use of the corrupted water will surely prove useful in our future efforts...
